scope_fields.accepted_hypotheses: A fixed finite set of at least two distinct primes, p the least prime; all positive smooth integers including 1; every repeated LCM occurrence counted; exact strict-prefix normalization P_a/p.

claims.statement: Lemma 2: weighted-simplex interval discrepancy uniform in interval endpoints
Closed-cube continuity and multiplicative face identities
Theorem 3: a nondegenerate interval contained in the subsequential limit set on each fixed arithmetic progression
Corollary 4: quantitative {2,3,5} progression oscillation and ratio bound
Corollaries 5-6: polynomial, quasipolynomial, and finite-family arbitrary-selection obstructions

scope_fields.singleton_exception: For P={p}, R_P=p/(p-1) and X_a=1/(p-1); oscillation and finite-polynomial obstruction would be false. Candidate correctly excludes it.

independent_finite_checks.method: Independent cumulative smooth counts between prime-power events; literal running LCM enumeration; independent outward-rounded -log(1-z) series; no candidate code imported or run.

qualifications: Ordinary proof audit, not formal verification or referee review.
No exhaustive novelty or priority claim.
Prior exact shell formulas and quadratic bounds attributed to Cook.
Prior two-prime transcendence statement not independently audited or used.
No claim that the entire subsequential limit set is one interval.
No uniform asymptotic error rate over varying prime sets.
No exclusion of arbitrary nonpolynomial integer carries.
excluded_claims: Irrationality proof or counterexample for the residual repeated-summand problem.
Cofinal residue escape for every denominator and onset.
scope_fields.packet_contains_only: This prose edition contains authored mathematical proof, complete independent audit, acceptance, and public source/verification metadata; no programs, detailed check outputs, raw datasets, certificates, copied source documents/text, private sources, private personal data, or private coordination material.

edition.review_status: These AI-assisted authored documents and their independent internal AI audit are unrefereed. Acceptance is limited to the stated partial analytic result. No external human peer review, journal acceptance, formal proof-assistant certification, exhaustive priority search, or novelty certification is claimed.

reason: The actual repeated running-LCM series remains undecided. A moving-phase a^(|P|-1) leading asymptotic, interval of normalized limits on each arithmetic progression and exclusion of finite polynomial/quasipolynomial corrections do not exclude arbitrary nonpolynomial integer carries under rationality. At three primes the error is o(a^2), not fractional-part control or o(1). The proof explicitly exhibits a rounded integral sequence with the same leading profile, without claiming it satisfies the true recurrence; no residue-escape theorem, irrationality proof or rational counterexample is supplied. Singleton supports and duplicate-removed variants are separate.
